HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately reflects the key financial terms and information present in the source document. All specific terms mentioned are supported by the source, including:

- Date of agreement (August 1, 2025)
- Borrower name (Millrose Properties, Inc., Maryland corporation)  
- Administrative agent (Goldman Sachs Bank USA)
- Lender names (Bank of America N.A., Citibank N.A., Citizens Bank N.A., JPMorgan Chase Bank N.A., Wells Fargo Bank N.A.)
- Stage 4 Funding Fee (0.250%)
- Timing of Stage 4 fee (270 days after Initial Draw Date)
- $500 million loan retention threshold for Designated Issuances
- Mandatory prepayment provisions
- 6-month reinvestment period for casualty/condemnation proceeds
- Original credit agreement date (June 24, 2025)

The memo appropriately marks unavailable information as "N/A" in the deal terms table rather than fabricating details not present in the source document. The business characterizations (real estate company, etc.) are reasonable inferences from the company name and document terms rather than fabricated financial details.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
- Initial Draw Date (referenced but not defined in the amendment)
- Specific loan facility structure details (Delayed Draw Term Loan Facility, Acquisition Tranche Commitments, General Tranche Commitments)
- Other existing funding fees (Stage 2 Funding Fee, Stage 3 Funding Fee, Initial Funding Fee are referenced but amounts not provided)
- Net Cash Proceeds definition and calculation methodology
- Collateral details and description of what assets secure the facility
- Borrowing Base Parties definition and composition
